attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `ydfI`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.2% of calls. The model names 94% of them, at 0.97 bits.

**The rest of the window is fork and variable columns**, 1 to 79, carried by 6 to 85%, in a region of plasticity in 8 to 90% of calls. A branch of 23 families runs through columns 2 to 24, a parallel path some chromosomes carry instead, 19 persistent and 4 shell, at 10 to 12%. The `lsr` genes, columns 25 to 32, are [[autoinducer 2 transport]].

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 94 against 87%, and hesitates more there, 0.97 against 0.71 bits. Its most hesitant column, 42, `fimC`, is a fork column, at 1.44 bits.

**The window ends on fork and variable columns.** Column 79, `YncO`, is carried by 16% of chromosomes. The `nar` genes, columns 70 to 73, are [[nitrate reductase]].

**Across the window it names 87% of genes**, 0.71 bits on average, perplexity 2.0 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.20 against 0.29 bits, and names fewer genes, 78% against 95%.

label: ydfI
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the ydfI window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ydfI, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,190 to 2,269 from dnaA. Read in 513 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ydfI once); 41,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 87% of genes, 0.71 bits on average (perplexity 2.0 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 20,718 calls, named 97%, 0.26 bits; shell 19,196 calls, named 80%, 1.00 bits; cloud 1,126 calls, named 25%, 4.17 bits. Outside an RGP 22,148 calls, named 95%, 0.29 bits; inside an RGP 18,892 calls, named 78%, 1.20 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 35 fork, 44 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.20 against 0.29 bits) and names fewer genes (78% against 95%); 18,892 of the 41,040 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 42 (fimC, a fork column) 1.44 bits, RGP 77%; column 37 (ydeQ, a variable column) 1.43 bits, RGP 81%; column 36 (ydeR, a variable column) 1.42 bits, RGP 86%. The 34 columns (columns 26-59) where most calls are in an RGP: named 82%, 1.01 bits on average; the other 46 columns: named 90%, 0.49 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 94%, 0.97 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 87%, 0.71 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates more there. Its most hesitant column, 42, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0.2%. Genes: ydfI "mannitol dehydrogenase family prote…". named 94%; 0.97 bits.
